label: LOGICALLY_NECESSARY_3: A proposition is LOGICALLY_NECESSARY_3 when its denial is contradictory
definition: A proposition is logically necessary when its denial is contradictory. A being whose non-existence would be contradictory would be 'necessary' in this sense.
note: Stipulative contrast with the tertia via's cannot-not-be and own/derived necessity. The necessary-being root now uses modal box-existence through NecessarySenseFork; that does not identify it with logical validity. NECESSARY_5 remains unbound and its allowance remains: this generic definition does not select a logic, formula translation or full admissible interpretation domain. Bounded analyst contrast in TruthCore.Causality.LogicalNecessityContrast uses the existing Modal.Formula, Formula.neg, Holds and Valid on an explicitly supplied frame, admitting ALL valuations and ALL worlds of that frame. DenialContradictory has the body not-exists V,w satisfying the denial; denialContradictory_iff_valid uses classical logic. Empty carriers are vacuous, so its positive identity and negative existence controls use the inhabited Unit frame. valid_truth_and_box preserves the same formula, frame and valuation. atom_not_valid shows every unconstrained atom invalid on every inhabited frame, including S5; route_existence_not_valid separates actual truth and box-existence from validity of that same existence atom. These helpers do not bind the original generic sense or prove God logically necessary. OPEN: choose explicit logic profiles and a translation of existence with full admitted domain. Full modal frame validity, all-frame K validity and first-order validity are different profiles; theory-relative entailment additionally needs a stated theory and a joint model. Restricting valuations to the route's existence model is not unrestricted logical validity. The first-order option can reuse Mathlib.ModelTheory.Semantics (already imported by Logic.ReferenceAnchor and Alternatives.PhysicalSpecification), but needs an existence signature and carrier/structure policy; nonempty carriers alone do not prove existence of a particular named being. A source claim is not being made. Follow-up specs/logical-necessity-profiles.toml implements three explicit siblings NECESSARY_13, NECESSARY_14, NECESSARY_15, full selected-frame/K/theory comparisons and a same-bearer dictionary bridge to the existing box-K root. The bridge does not identify generic NECESSARY_5 with any sibling; the original declaration gap and allowance are retained. First-order validity, intended-reading coverage/exclusivity and reality calibration remain OPEN.
